CUT&RUN downstream analysis

Scope and identity

GSE186608 HCT116 H3K27ac CUT&RUN downstream reanalysis

Data status: PUBLIC DATA REANALYSIS - GSE186608 HCT116 H3K27ac

This downstream report starts from an explicit consensus-peak-by-sample integer count matrix. It does not call peaks, count BAM files, reproduce upstream alignment QC, or run DiffBind. Peak coordinates remain stable identifiers throughout the analysis.

Normalization limitation

DESeq2 median-of-ratios normalization is used here. It estimates relative occupancy under the assumption that most retained peaks do not shift together. A widespread CUT&RUN occupancy change can violate that assumption, so this run alone cannot establish a global gain or loss of signal. If validated spike-in or other external scaling factors are available, rerun with provided_deseq2_size_factors and document how those factors were derived.

Optional genomic annotation

Annotation completed with TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene and org.Hs.eg.db. Build and seqname compatibility were checked before annotation; annotation columns are included in each contrast result.

Interpretation boundary

The exported tables support review of differential peaks and transformed-count patterns. This compact workflow intentionally omits the original exploratory derivative networks, online enrichment, WikiPathways, Cytoscape examples, and cross-mark notebooks. Those sections require separate redesign, validated thresholds, and explicit reference provenance before they can be presented as a reusable analysis.
